scope: All upstream-added paths between common baseline and b19ae154; read-only Git tree/index plus raw worktree bytes/modes. Existing shared-document integration changes are listed separately. No source, index, refs or previous ledger modified.

method.oidAlgorithm: SHA1 of ASCII blob + space + decimal byte length + NUL + raw bytes; symbolic links use link-target bytes.
method.worktreePolicy: Compare every newly added file byte-for-byte by Git blob OID and mode; each read checks its new-file stat before/after. No old 29406-file mtime audit performed.
